note: Toolbar action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for file and edit operations (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, Print)
Toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view and mode switches (e.g., Show Line Numbers, Show Right Margin, Fullscreen)
Toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for status indicators and field labels (e.g., Encoding, Line Ending, Zoom Level)
